# Curbpack

> Curbpack checks your repository against local rule packs and writes a review pack you can hand to a buyer or auditor—on your machine, without claiming certification.
>
> Not conformity assessment. Not CE marking. Not a notified-body opinion.

## What

Local-first CLI. Rule packs on disk. Review pack for human review. Green gates mean “ready for a human to look,” not “approved.”

## Three ways in

Write starts with **curb outlines (your pathway sketch)**. After pack confirm, a **local pack→rule map** steers drafting—not a legal oracle—then dual drafts → cite-check refuses uncited Claims. Bring existing docs onto pack paths, or CI alone — same local `check`. Human confirms use a TTY or `--i-am-human`. Research briefs never gate pass/fail.

## What you get

- Gate report (every check): JSON + markdown — structural evidence
- Review pack + buyer one-pager (after green + share): hand to buyer
- Attest capsule (human attest): unsigned ≠ verified
- Proof page (after attest): local proof/index.html — still human judgment

## What not

- Not conformity assessment / CE / notified-body approval
- Not a cloud GRC / regulation chat KB

## Start

- **Read-only first contact:** `npx curbpack@0.5.2 scan` — no init, no files written; scan defaults to cra-baseline + Art 14 clock
- Repo (primary): https://github.com/RI-SE/curbpack — mirror: https://github.com/afelin/curbpack
- Site (credibility home): https://ri-se.github.io/curbpack/ — optional mirror: https://afelin.github.io/curbpack/
- Install (dual fence — PowerShell | macOS/Linux): https://github.com/afelin/curbpack/blob/main/docs/getting-started/install.md
- Troubleshooting: https://github.com/afelin/curbpack/blob/main/docs/getting-started/troubleshooting.md
- Three ways in / builders: https://ri-se.github.io/curbpack/for-builders/
- Pathway (Write depth): https://github.com/RI-SE/curbpack/blob/main/docs/getting-started/pathway.md
- Authorities: https://ri-se.github.io/curbpack/for-authorities/
- White paper: https://ri-se.github.io/curbpack/whitepaper/
- Voice: https://github.com/RI-SE/curbpack/blob/main/docs/voice-and-terms.md
- Assistant contract: https://github.com/RI-SE/curbpack/blob/main/docs/assistant-loop.md
- Red: `curbpack check --heal` then `curbpack ask … --propose`, then re-check — never invent green
- Green handoff: `curbpack share` (check → context-pack → buyer-questions → prepare-release)
- `curb` = short alias for `curbpack` (same binary) — only after install
- ContextPack: `curbpack export --context-pack`
- Thin MCP example: https://github.com/RI-SE/curbpack/tree/main/examples/mcp
- Pin: `@v0.5.2` (Action = Linux/macOS runners; local CLI includes Windows)

## Optional depth

- Pathway / research / dual-draft / cite-check: https://github.com/RI-SE/curbpack/blob/main/docs/getting-started/pathway.md (research never gates check; cite-check before confirm-prose)
